title: Minor esthetic bug : Black on gray text
symptom: Black text/buttons appear on gray background in preference settings and other areas, making them hard to see. This occurs in various dialogs and number pickers.
cause: The text color on buttons is based on `colorPrimary`, and the night theming is not using the default style correctly. The main activity is not in the real dark mode.
fix: The issue is solved in the Themeswitcher branch for light and dark mode, and there are plans to merge it in the future. A fix is planned by osodebailar to address the root cause.
evidence_quote: The text color on buttons are based on `colorPrimary`. The night theming, is not using the default style correctly. This requires a bit of rework.
